name: performance-profiler
description: Script/function profiling, memory analysis, startup measurement, bottleneck detection, and HAR import for flow replay

envVars.name: PERF_PROFILER_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS
envVars.description: Set to "true" to allow profiling endpoints on private/loopback addresses. Off by default as an SSRF guard.

envVars.name: PERF_PROFILER_ALLOW_RAW_CODE
envVars.description: Set to "true" to allow benchmarking arbitrary code snippets. Off by default because it executes what it is given.
